admission.justification: Alternative positions are not stable identities; a reordering or obsolete same-leaf refresh must not silently retarget a stored authorial reconsideration link.

applicability: Updates to existing decision alternatives without explicitly supplied links, and restoration of an eligible same-leaf still_rejected subject absent from the current reconsideration item map.
conditions: For each stored reconsider_on link, preserve the exact unique old alternative option text in the new alternatives; missing or ambiguous matches require explicitly restated links and otherwise refuse the operation.

Restoration requires existing current and base decisions, the same link relation/alternative, the same target path/locator and base-target content that resolves current at the candidate. Restore the whole base link only when it differs and these guards hold.
Only this leaf history supplies the stored still_rejected subjects, and a currently present reconsideration subject is not auto-restored.
exclusions: An explicit links field owns the replacement and suppresses automatic option remapping; other link relations are not remapped.
No arbitrary decision mutation, path/locator recovery, cross-leaf or non-leaf restoration, transitive trigger evaluation or replacement of INV-YA1T3N trigger/gate meaning.
statement: Stored reconsideration links follow uniquely preserved alternative option text unless explicitly restated, and an eligible unfired same-leaf refresh restores its current base link.
